title: Kevin Warsh to Make First Jackson Hole Speech as Fed Chair
summary: New Fed Chair Kevin Warsh delivers his inaugural keynote at the Jackson Hole Economic Policy Symposium (Aug 27-29) on Friday, Aug 28. The event lands 19 days before the September 16 FOMC decision; Warsh has curtailed forward guidance since taking office in May.
why: 9月FOMC会议前最重要的政策信号窗口；Warsh刻意压缩前瞻指引，演讲立场偏鸽或偏鹰均将直接影响9月降息预期，期权卖方需关注演讲前后隐含波动率变化。

title: S&P 500 posts weekly loss as 30-year Treasury yield hits near 19-year high of 5.273%
summary: U.S. stocks fell 1.4% for the week ending Aug 21; the 30-year Treasury yield reached 5.273%, a near 19-year high. Treasury Secretary Bessent doubled long-term debt buybacks to $4B/operation to subdue yields. S&P 500 recovered 0.4% Friday to 7,674 after three sessions of losses.
why: 长端利率急升压制科技/成长股估值，Sell-put策略需关注Delta对冲成本抬升；同时为Jackson Hole会议铺垫了紧迫政策背景。

title: Nvidia reports Q2 FY2027 earnings on Aug 26; revenue consensus $93–95B, +97% YoY
summary: Nvidia's Q2 FY2027 earnings (period ending July 27) are due after-market Wednesday, Aug 26. Analyst consensus for revenue is ~$93–95 billion vs. company guidance midpoint of $91B. Options markets imply a ~5.4% earnings-day move. Blackwell GPU ramp and data center demand are the key focus.
why: 英伟达是AI资本支出周期的最直接读数；业绩指引若超预期将强化持仓中的科技/AI相关标的（腾讯云、阿里云、SK海力士HBM需求等）；期权隐含波动率约5.4%，可关注earnings前后波动率压缩机会。

title: Walmart Q2 FY2027: U.S. same-store sales growth hits 6-year low; stock falls nearly 10%
summary: Walmart reported Q2 FY2027 on Aug 20: revenue $187.94B (+5.9% YoY) beat, but U.S. comparable sales growth of 2.6% was the weakest in more than six years, and full-year adjusted EPS guidance of $2.80–$2.87 missed the ~$2.90 consensus. Shares fell ~10%.
why: 沃尔玛是美国消费支出的晴雨表；同店增速创6年新低暗示通胀疲劳型消费降级，对麦当劳、好市多等消费持仓的宏观背景不利；也令美股整体本周承压。

title: Bitcoin posts best week in two years; US-Iran 'economic warfare' adds geopolitical risk
summary: As the week closed Aug 21, bitcoin recorded its best weekly performance in two years. Separately, the Trump administration announced an 'economic warfare' plan against Iran, adding a new geopolitical overlay to already-elevated Treasury yields and equity volatility.
why: 比特币强势直接利好Circle(CRCL)等加密基础设施；美伊紧张局势是全球风险溢价的额外变量，若升级将压制权益资产、支撑黄金及老铺黄金相关标的。

title: Pop Mart Unveils Up to 5 Billion Yuan Buyback as Overseas Revenue Falls
summary: Pop Mart (9992.HK) H1 2026: revenue RMB 17.17B (+23.8% YoY), China +47.3%; Asia-Pacific ex-China -9.7%, Americas -16.5%; total overseas -11.1%. CEO Wang Ning announced a 2–5 billion yuan buyback in the next 6 months. HK shares fell over 4% on results. Gross margin 69.7%.
why: 海外收入下滑是核心利空，揭示Labubu热度降温；但回购计划（20-50亿元规模）提供股价支撑，暗示管理层对估值有信心——可关注Sell put机会；Labubu×三丽鸥联名是潜在破圈催化剂。

title: Tesla, Uber, Waymo get Nevada permit for thousands of robotaxis; Cybercab Austin launch imminent
summary: Nevada's Transportation Authority approved Tesla's permit on Aug 20 to operate up to 5,000 robotaxis in Clark County (Las Vegas area), expanding from a previous cap of 10. Commercial Cybercab rides in Austin, Texas, are expected to launch by end of August. Tesla shares gained on the news Friday.
why: 延续报道：Nevada许可是特斯拉Robotaxi商业化的重要里程碑；Cybercab奥斯汀即将开城，是FSD叙事的关键验证节点；对TSLA Sell put策略而言，持续正面催化降低短期行权风险。

title: PDD Holdings (Pinduoduo) reports Q2 2026 before market open Monday Aug 24
summary: PDD Holdings will release Q2 2026 results before U.S. market open on Aug 24. Key watch: whether Temu's global sales growth is sustainable and profit margin trends, given heavy marketing and logistics investment. Analyst consensus holds a Moderate Buy with avg target ~$110.
why: 即将发布（明天）的业绩是近期最重要的中概股催化剂之一；Temu增速是否持续、利润率是否改善，将决定拼多多能否摆脱估值压制；持有或考虑Sell put的投资者需关注业绩公布风险。

title: 雷军微博：小米SU7赢川渝往返700km续航挑战，实测达成率80.46%十车第一
summary: 小米创始人雷军于8月22日发微博，公布川渝往返700km高速+山区路况测试结果：小米SU7以724.9km实测续航、80.46%达成率位列十款主流长续航纯电车第一，是唯一完成往返全程未趴窝的车型。
why: 产品力口碑验证是小米汽车品牌溢价的关键——直接对比竞品的实测胜利有助于稳固SU7在20万+纯电轿车的龙头地位，支撑交付量持续增长预期，对持有小米(1810.HK)头寸为正向催化。

title: 腾讯控股8月21日回购66.7万股，涉资约3亿港元，持续高频回购中
summary: 腾讯控股(00700)于2026年8月21日在联交所回购66.7万股普通股，每股回购价介于HKD 445.2至457，总代价约3亿港元。这是腾讯近期高频回购的持续，Q2累计已斥资约169亿港元回购3,738万股。
why: 腾讯持续以大手笔回购做多自家股票，为现有持仓提供估值底部支撑；对Covered Call卖出方而言，管理层积极托市降低了深度跌穿行权价的概率；需关注后续是否出现回购节奏放缓信号。
